title: Agriculture Department: Rural Economic Development Loan and Grant Programs
summary: This action modifies the regulations for the Rural Economic Development Loan and Grant Programs. This revised regulation is written in a format that is simpler in design and should improve ease of use by the public and program beneficiaries.
